{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicates based on patient_id, keeping the one with highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 in biomarker_baseline with NaN
trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check the distribution of treatment arms across sex
print("Distribution of arms by sex:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['arm']))

# Check the distribution of severity by sex
print("\nDistribution of severity by sex:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['severity']))

# Check the distribution of severity by arm
print("\nDistribution of severity by arm:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity']))"}
